_comment: Reading shelf. Add an object per book; it renders on the page AND becomes cat-able at /shelf/<id> in the terminal. Both locales required. `year` is the work's original publication, not when it was read.

author.zh: 迪帕克·马尔霍特拉、马克斯·巴泽曼

note.en: Harvard Business School's negotiation course in book form: investigative negotiation, and what to do when you hold no leverage at all.
note.zh: 哈佛商学院谈判课的书面版：调查式谈判，以及在毫无筹码时该怎么做。

note.en: The four dialogues around the trial and execution — Euthyphro, Apology, Crito, Phaedo.
note.zh: 围绕审判与赴死的四篇对话：《欧绪弗洛》《申辩》《克力同》《斐多》。

note.en: A three-volume historical novel following Zeng from the raising of the Xiang Army through the late Qing.
note.zh: 三卷本历史小说，写曾国藩从组建湘军到晚清仕途的一生。

note.en: Eighteen short chapters on endurance and self-discipline. Traditionally attributed to Zeng, though the attribution is disputed.
note.zh: 十八章短论，讲隐忍与自律。旧题曾国藩所作，其真伪历来存疑。

note.en: The core record of Wang Yangming's teaching, and the source of the unity of knowing and acting.
note.zh: 阳明心学的核心语录，知行合一的出处。
